prompt:
Create ONE scroll-stopping vertical video cover (thumbnail), 9:16 portrait, for a short Malay video about a young person who stops traffic to help an elderly man cross a busy road while everyone else drives past.

VISUAL STYLE (from my style library, "Kilauan anamorfik"): a dark scene with a long horizontal electric-blue anamorphic lens streak stretching across the middle of the frame. Palette: black and electric blue with white highlights. Cinematic, futuristic, high contrast, filmic haze. Fill the whole canvas edge to edge, no letterbox bars, no borders, no empty padding.

The attached image is ONLY a character reference: keep the same pure-white minimalist stick-figure characters (a tall young figure with a soft white glow, and a smaller hunched elderly figure with a walking cane). Do NOT copy its composition or layout. Make a completely new, dramatic scene.

SCENE: a very low camera at road level at night. Far in the middle of the frame, a pair of blinding car headlights flares into the long blue-white horizontal anamorphic streak, with extra lens flares and light rays spreading across the wet black asphalt. In front of the streak, as sharp silhouettes, the hunched elderly figure with his cane and the glowing young figure stand side by side in the middle of the road. The young figure holds one palm up like a shield and the rays of light visibly stop and bend at his hand. A thin glowing line of light connects the young figure's other hand to the old man's hand. The wet road reflects the streak and the two figures. The two characters must be clearly readable, not too small, and placed in the middle third of the image.

HEADLINE TEXT (the only text in the image, in Malay, written EXACTLY with this spelling, ultra-bold heavy wide sans-serif, huge, centred just UNDER the light streak, inside safe margins, well above the bottom fifth of the image so nothing is cut off, with a heavy dark outline so it stays readable on a phone):
Line 1: TIADA SIAPA BERHENTI...  (pure white)
Line 2: KECUALI DIA.  (electric blue with a soft glowing blue edge, noticeably larger than line 1)

Do NOT add any other text, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, borders or UI elements.
